description: Page heading outline + audit — Fetch a public web page and return its h1-h6 heading outline (level, text, id and anchor link) as JSON and as an indented markdown outline, plus counts per level and the page title. Audits the structure for SEO and accessibility: missing or multiple h1, first heading not h1, skipped levels (h2 to h4), empty, overly long and duplicate headings, giving a 0-100 score and A-F grade. Scripts and styles are ignored. Optional limit= (default 200, max 500). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_headings
